name: maxGraph
summary: The strongest open-source, permissive, framework-agnostic editing alternative. The spike rendered and batch-inserted the same graph with zero runtime dependencies. It is a rewrite, not a drop-in, and is still pre-1.0.
gains: Full diagram editing, layouts, undo/redo and custom shapes
losses: Smaller ecosystem than X6 or GoJS
X6 custom shapes and React shape packages do not carry over
Some X6 plugin-level features need a parity spike

spike.scenario: 20 nodes, 20 edges, batch insert, panning, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: Basic editing model rendered. Clipboard, snap lines, minimap and image export were not exercised; treat those as parity-spike gaps.
